age_trajectory.description: Young woman with dark, wavy hair styled short or pinned up. She is wearing a long, solid-colored dress with a V-neck, a wide decorative belt, and a long pendant necklace.
Woman on the left with dark hair worn full, a dark headband across her forehead, wearing a dark dress with a plaid or striped sleeve detail, holding a light-colored corsage.
Young woman with dark hair styled with a forehead band, wearing a plaid dress with a dark over-collar, holding a floral corsage.
Standing woman on the left, smiling, wearing a dark hat with feather trim and a dark wrap coat.
Young woman seated on the left, wearing a dark bathing suit and a gathered bathing cap.
Woman standing on the left, wearing a dark hat with a feather or embellishment, a dark coat, and a light V-neck top. She is smiling slightly.
Woman seated on the left, wearing a dark hat with a veil, dark coat with fur collar.
Older woman with short dark hair, wearing round glasses and a dark floral dress.
Young man standing on the right, wearing a dark suit jacket, white shirt with a high rounded collar, and a patterned tie. Likely Albert Fox.
Man in the background, partially obscured, balding.
Older man, short graying hair, wearing round wire-rimmed glasses, shirtless, holding a cigarette.
Young boy, sitting with knees up, dark hair, shirtless.
Older man with short grey hair, wearing glasses, shirtless, applying lotion.
Woman seated center-left, wearing a dark dress with a light collar.
Older woman seated, wearing a dark dress and a hat.
Young boy sitting on a man's lap, wearing a patterned short-sleeve shirt.
Elderly man wearing glasses, a grey fedora, a grey scarf, and a grey overcoat. He has a slight smile.
Older woman with short, dark, wavy hair, smiling, wearing a dark one-piece swimsuit.
Smiling man with short hair, wearing a short-sleeved button-down shirt and dark trousers.
Older man with receding grey hair, wearing glasses and a white short-sleeve shirt.
Older woman with short, dark curly hair showing some gray, wearing thick-framed cat-eye glasses, seen in profile kissing the baby.
Young woman with short dark hair, wearing a sleeveless floral dress.
Standing far left, wearing a dark suit, white shirt, dark bow tie, and glasses.
Older man, shirtless, wearing light-colored swim trunks, short grey/white hair, holding a cigarette.
Person seated in the background wearing a light-colored top and a conical hat.
Older woman wearing a black one-piece swimsuit and a wide-brimmed straw hat, smiling.
Older man, balding with white hair, shirtless, wearing patterned swim trunks, holding a cigarette. Likely Albert Fox.
Man wearing glasses, a short-sleeved shirt, and a tie. Likely Albert (Elia Ellis) Fox.
Older man wearing glasses, a short-sleeved light-colored shirt, a wide tie, and light trousers.
Older woman with dark, styled hair, wearing glasses and a dark, patterned, mid-calf length dress.
Older female with dark hair styled in a bouffant, wearing dangling earrings and a sleeveless dark dress with sparkly details.
Woman with teased brown hair, wearing a green and purple floral dress, holding a drink.
Middle-aged man wearing a dark suit, bow tie, and kippah, likely Roland Fox.
Woman with dark hair, wearing a light blazer and a large purple bow blouse, smiling and assisting the elderly man.
Older man with a mustache, wearing a grey suit and dark tie with a tie clip, standing behind the main subject.
Middle-aged man with dark, slightly wavy hair, wearing a light grey suit, pale yellow shirt, and dark tie. He is smiling and looking down towards a piece of paper he is holding.
Elderly man with thinning white hair, wearing thick-rimmed glasses, a dark suit, light blue shirt, and a patterned tie.
Standing man on the left, wearing a light-colored suit, striped tie, and sporting a full grey beard. Likely a son of the seated man.
Seated on the left, wearing a dark suit with a white blouse and a gold brooch. She has styled white hair.
Seated elderly woman wearing a dark suit, white blouse, and gold jewelry, holding a blue purse.
Standing man on the right, wearing a dark pinstripe suit and patterned tie. Likely a son of the seated man.
Seated on the right, wearing a grey suit, dark tie, large wire-rimmed glasses, and a white boutonniere. He is holding a wooden cane.
Seated elderly man wearing a grey suit, large glasses, and a boutonniere, holding a cane. Identified as Albert Fox.
Woman seated in the background, wearing a light blouse and dark cardigan, resting her chin on her hand.
Standing on the left, wearing a tan suit jacket and patterned tie.
Woman in the background wearing a light-colored suit.
Standing on the left, wearing a light-colored suit jacket, striped tie, and a grey beard. He appears to be wearing a light-colored kippah.
